snippet.title: Recycle Rivals | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Share a junkyard with your rivals. Scavenge it, sort it, build from it, and make it pay before they do.

Recycle Rivals is a multiplayer junkyard rivalry game. Players share one finite yard, scavenge scrap, sort it into material, and invent tools and machines from what they find. Then they run what they built so it pays out. Every invention turns a kind of junk that was scenery into income, so you always have to invent one step ahead of what the yard gives you.

The demo is out now. Try it on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447800/Recycle_Rivals/?beta=0
